_comment: sim-preplace-wrist2-hold-v1: stop the carried-preplace wrist_2 GIVE-WAY so the pre-place is not a coin toss. Keeps the welded carton parallel to the ground (2.0 deg bound / 0.15 s grace, NEVER loosened). ROOT CAUSE (cw66, named on CPU from cw66 vs cw64 -- IDENTICAL config): wrist_2 reached its commanded 0.6678 rad (closest approach 0.0006 at sim ~206) and was HELD there on the SOFT carried drive (kp 3e5 / eff 400) through the end of leg 1; then leg 2's 1.69 rad shoulder_pan sweep (1.27 -> -0.43) back-drove the still-soft HELD wrist_2 off its target -- a smooth continuous decline 0.666 -> 0.097 over sim 212-221 then a limit cycle around -0.3264 that never re-converged, so the convergence guard faulted at 30 s (cw66 host-stack.log PHASE_CONVERGENCE joint=ur_wrist_2_joint commanded=0.6678 executed=-0.3264 drifted 0.9935 from closest approach 0.0006). It is NOT a +/-2pi wrap (-0.3264 is neither 0.6678+/-2pi), NOT a one-tick jump, and the command stream stayed ALIVE (still commanded 0.6678 at the fault). cw64 ran the SAME trajectory, dipped to 0.58 at the same pan angle, and RECOVERED -- the soft held wrist holding the dynamic pan-sweep reaction is a coin toss. The static hold is trivial (gravity on wrist_2 is 0.045 N*m), so the give-way is purely the DYNAMIC pan-sweep reaction on the soft HELD wrist. Default-OFF (byte-identical); builds on the sim-preplace-per-joint-gains-v1 config (kept verbatim).

_mechanism.a_hold_firm_on_arrival_RUNTIME: phase_drive.hold_firm_on_arrival. Once a carried-preplace joint ARRIVES at its settled commanded target it is swing-SAFE to stiffen -- it is no longer moving, so firming it CANNOT reintroduce the carton swing the soft profile kills (physics_setup's 'never re-stiffen a MOVING wrist' invariant does not apply to a HELD one). isaac_port runs the pure HoldFirmOnArrival decider each preplace tick (reads the gate's streamed command target vs the measured position) and, when a joint's command has stayed settled for dwell_ticks AND the joint is within tol_rad of it, switches THAT joint's PhysX drive to the firm hold profile (set_arm_drive_gains_per_joint) and logs PREPLACE_HOLD_FIRM. So wrist_2 (arrived at the end of leg 1) is held FIRM through leg 2's pan sweep and cannot be back-driven. The decision is monotonic within the phase and reset on phase exit (the phase transition re-applies the full per-phase plan, restoring the soft wrist drive). shoulder_pan is excluded by default (already firm via carried_joint_profile). This is the PREVENTION.
_mechanism.b_drift_recapture_HOST: convergence_guard drift re-capture. If a driven preplace joint still drifts off its closest approach by more than preplace_drift_recapture_rad (and per-joint budget remains), the guard emits a NON-terminal DriftRecapture: the controller RE-ISSUES the armed preplace goal (re-driving the back-driven joint) and logs PREPLACE_DRIFT_RECAPTURE once, instead of waiting out the 30 s stall and faulting. The static hold is trivial, so a re-issue after the disturbing pan leg settles holds. Bounded per joint (preplace_drift_recapture_max); when the budget is spent on a joint that keeps re-drifting it still falls through to the terminal PHASE_CONVERGENCE fail-by-name. This is the BACKSTOP.
_mechanism._cpu_proof: test_preplace_wrist2_hold_v1.py: (1) replays the REAL cw66 wrist_2 CARTON_TICK trace (fixtures/preplace_wrist2_cw66.json) through the guard -- key OFF faults at the recorded sim 240.55 on ur_wrist_2_joint, key ON emits a DriftRecapture at the drift onset (~sim 210.65) and reaches NO terminal fault within the recorded trace; (2) the HoldFirmOnArrival decider latches an arrived joint firm, NEVER firms a sweeping (moving-command) joint, is monotonic, and is a no-op disabled; (3) the controller re-issues the goal + logs once + stays non-terminal with the key on, and fails-by-name with no re-issue with it off; (4) config_preflight validates the new keys. No Isaac/ROS/GPU.

env._note: UNCHANGED from cw66. The arm-carry mode (RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE / CARRY) and the ground-truth / verify switches are exactly the cw66 values -- this lane adds only the two config sub-keys below.

runtime_config._file: mission-runtime-*.json (EXTERNAL to the repo; the integration lane owns it). The ONLY new key this lane adds is phase_drive.hold_firm_on_arrival; carried_soft_phases + carried_joint_profile (sim-preplace-per-joint-gains-v1) and the rest of the cw66 block are UNCHANGED.

phase_drive._hold_firm_on_arrival_note: NEW, OPTIONAL (default absent / enabled false => byte-identical). Firms any carried-preplace joint once it ARRIVES at its settled command, so the leg-2 pan sweep cannot back-drive the arrived wrist_2. 'firm' defaults to the carried_joint_profile preplace shoulder_pan override (kp 1e6 / eff 2000 -- the proven firm hold); 'joints' defaults to every arm joint EXCEPT shoulder_pan (already firm). Set 'firm' / 'joints' explicitly only to override. config_preflight.check_phase_drive_hold_firm validates it. RUNTIME key (isaac_port/physics_setup), NOT a HOST key.

host_config._file: scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json (resolved by ros_host.py -> TransferController). The cw66 carton_level + per-joint-gains block is KEPT verbatim; this lane adds the two OPTIONAL drift-recapture keys below (the convergence guard must be armed).
host_config._preplace_convergence_stall_s_note: KEPT from the per-joint-gains lane (the guard must be armed for drift re-capture to run). SIM seconds; names a frozen joint ~90 s before the 120 s phase timeout.
host_config._preplace_drift_recapture_rad_note: NEW, OPTIONAL (default 0 => off => byte-identical). Radians of drift from the closest approach that triggers a re-issue (the backstop). 0.05 = the convergence tol; must be above the 0.01 improvement eps (config_preflight.check_preplace_convergence_keys refuses a smaller bound as a jitter-storm risk).
host_config._preplace_drift_recapture_max_note: NEW, OPTIONAL (default 0 => off). Per-joint re-capture budget. 3 covers the ~21 s leg-2 back-drive window (re-issue, re-converge after the pan settles); when spent on a joint that keeps re-drifting it still falls through to the terminal PHASE_CONVERGENCE fail-by-name.
host_config._carton_level_and_per_joint_kept: preplace_level_gate, preplace_above_support, place_contact_release, gravity_compensation, closed_loop_sensor, station_place_full_brake, chassis_station_pitch_hold_* -- the cw66 values, UNCHANGED. The 2.0 deg / 0.15 s carton bound is UNTOUCHED.

acceptance_coldwin67._how: relaunch the cw66 config with the one new RUNTIME key phase_drive.hold_firm_on_arrival (+ the two HOST preplace_drift_recapture_* keys as the backstop); config_preflight PASS. Watch the Isaac log for PREPLACE_HOLD_FIRM joints=...wrist_2... around the end of the preplace leg-1 (proves the arrival switch fired).
acceptance_coldwin67.wrist_2_holds_through_leg2: wrist_2 executed stays within ~0.05 rad of its commanded 0.6678 through the shoulder_pan sweep -- NO collapse to a negative limit cycle; NO PHASE_CONVERGENCE fault
acceptance_coldwin67.drift_recapture_is_a_backstop_not_the_no: ideally NO PREPLACE_DRIFT_RECAPTURE at all (hold-firm prevented the drift); a bounded 1-3 PREPLACE_DRIFT_RECAPTURE that then re-converges is acceptable; repeated re-captures to exhaustion -> the terminal fault names the joint
acceptance_coldwin67.CARTON_TICK_preplace_tilt_peak_deg: <= 1.5 (firming a HELD joint does not move it, so the predicted tilt is unchanged from the soft-hold prediction cw66 showed at 1.36 deg; the 2.0 deg bound holds)
acceptance_coldwin67.preplace_converges_and_advances: the standoff converges, the place descent + release run, and the run advances PAST collect
acceptance_coldwin67._if_wrist_2_still_gives_way: the drift re-capture backstop re-drives it (PREPLACE_DRIFT_RECAPTURE); if that is exhausted the PHASE_CONVERGENCE line names the joint. Next levers: lower hold_firm dwell_ticks to 2 (firm sooner) or tol_rad to 0.03 (firm closer in), or add ur_wrist_1_joint explicitly if a second wrist gives way.
